![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png)

**Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.**
Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalpensaICQualifier2023#34636-registration-registrazione-faq).

##### Only the first 15 people that register for big blind and multi-blind events will be allowed to compete. Read more in the [dedicated tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalpensaICQualifier2023#34641-big-bld-and-multi-blind)
